responsibility: Implements a binary-tree symbol table keyed by NameKey interned names and storing associated symbol numbers, with operations for insertion, lookup, deletion, emptiness tests, conditional traversal, and node counting. Unlike NameKey, which interns raw strings globally, this module manages per-tree mappings from name keys to symbol keys for compiler-style symbol storage and search.
same_name_distinction: Defines the SymbolKey tree node layout and the executable binary-tree algorithms themselves—allocation, search, insertion, deletion, traversal, and counting—whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/GSymbolKey.h only exposes the opaque SymbolTree type and function declarations for that API.
